name: Fabric Graph enforces OneLake security for governed graph access
description: Fabric Graph conforms to OneLake security so that access controls defined over lake data are enforced consistently when data is represented and queried as a graph. Row , column , and object level policies apply end to end, preventing graphs from becoming an alternate access path. This alignment ensures customers can adopt Fabric Graph without introducing new security models or weakening existing governance and compliance controls.
